senses.gloss: रराट rarā́ṭa, n. forehead, brow (= lalā́ṭa): 🞄ī́, f. garland of Darbha grass affixed to the 🞄eastern entrance of the shed for the Havirdhānas 🞄(ritual).

रराट्य rarāṭya, a. relating to the forehead: 🞄ā̂, f. horizon;
 = rarāṭi.

रराण rár-āṇa, pr. pt. √ rā, give;
 -imā́, 1 pl. 🞄pf. √ rā.
